description: A screenshot of a user administration interface for the CLC+ (CORINE Land Cover Plus) Core system, displaying a modal confirmation dialog to disable 10m resolution processing. The page title is "User 'CLC+ Core User Admin/Support'" with an "ACTIVE" status badge. General Information fields include EIONET Username "clccore", Last name "CLC+ Core", First name "User Admin/Support", Organisation/s "CLC" and "European Environment Agency (EEA)", Email "jgaguilar@bilbomatica.es", and Status "active". A button labelled "VISIT EIONET FOR CONTACT DETAILS" is present. The "Roles" section is partially obscured by the modal, showing columns for "Name" and "Description", with a visible role entry "Database Administrator" and associated description "For now, this role is only available within CLCplus Core so that it can be seen who is the database administrator. For later additional views like e.g., performance view." The "Advanced options" section shows "10 m processing" with a green toggle switch, indicating it is currently active. The modal dialog, titled "Are you sure you want to disable the 10m resolution option?", warns that "Disabling this option will prevent users from running 10 m processing in CLC+ Core" and states "This action is intended to be permanent and should only be used when 10 m processing must be switched off globally." It provides "CLOSE" and "DEACTIVATE" (green) buttons. The page header contains navigation links to "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users", along with "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support" and notification icons on the right. Action buttons "DEACTIVATE" (red) and "EDIT" (green) are visible in the top right. The footer includes logos for Copernicus, EIONET Action Group EAGLE, European Environment Agency, and European Commission.
